name: yotta-memory
description: Yuanyi (元忆) — boundary-aware, file-based memory for AI agents. File-based, zero-dependency, diff/rollback-able; FACT/PREF/BOUND/COMMIT types (public shared / private isolated), user-level + project-level storage; v0.10 consolidation (periodic summaries with provenance, near-duplicate auto-merge, per-type decay, batch audit + rollback), v0.9 recall quality + context focus + optional local embedding plugin, plus v0.8 semantic search, feedback loop, self-organization and distillation.
